item.title: 《小巴辣子》71沪语单口喜剧专场·SpicyComedy
item.description:
• 演出日期：2026.2.20-23
  • 入场时间：约演出前30-60分钟
  • 演出类型：脱口秀
  • 演出时长：90分钟
  • 演出语言：沪语

演出介绍

演员71将带来全新沪语单口喜剧专场《小巴辣子》，把生活里的精打细算、小人物的日常观察、不起眼却自成一派的处世哲学搬上舞台。

“小”是自知分量，“辣”是暗藏锋芒，以小见大，在笑声中照见城市与人情，让有意思的人讲给懂生活的你听。

这次专场的段子，是71五年来讲单口的精选合集，建议听过2次以上拼盘演出的观众谨慎购买。
就把专场当作从事喜剧五年的一次汇报演出，趁着过年，和大家一起开心开心。

主创团队

主创团队：SpicyComedy

制作公司：上海笑悟文化传媒有限公司

剧情梗概

舞台只留给71，一人开讲，一场到底

媒体评论

他并非竞技型选手，也没有登上那些热门的脱口秀竞赛节目。他清楚地知道，自己“叙事型、像朋友聊天”的风格，与节目中需要高度浓缩、密集包袱的“编剧型”段子有所不同。他欣赏美国脱口秀演员凯文·哈特，因为他“就讲自己家里那点事儿”，真实而有温度。
——新民周刊

今天站在脱口秀舞台上的主角叫“71”，是SpicyComedy的一名脱口秀演员。近期，他的脱口秀短视频在线上吸粉无数，线下的演出门票几乎场场秒空。他谈论的话题从恋爱相亲、到职场困境；从育儿烦恼、到中年危机，老少咸宜，几乎没有他接不住的梗。
——看看新闻

item.title: 音乐剧明星洛朗·班音乐会
item.description:
• 演出日期：2026.3.14-2026.3.15
  • 入场时间：约演出前30-60分钟
  • 演出类型：音乐会

  • 演出语言：法语

演出介绍

       2026音乐剧明星音乐会系列

        2026年新春，一场跨越语言与舞台的星光盛宴即将璀璨启幕。从伦敦西区《悲惨世界》的传奇救赎，到百老汇《西贡小姐》的时代悲歌；从法语音乐剧的浪漫诗意，到德奥舞台上的古典厚重——那些活在歌声里的灵魂，即将走出剧情，在同一个舞台上相遇。

        作为“演艺大世界——2026上海国际音乐剧节”的重磅章节，本次音乐会系列汇聚伦敦西区、纽约百老汇、德奥与法语音乐剧领域的领军之声。他们中既有多次登台文化广场的挚友，也有首次以个人音乐会亮相上海舞台的实力唱将。

        跨越整个春天，十余场演出将陆续绽放。这不仅是一次剧目的浓缩回顾，更是一场舞台上的深度对话——在他们的经典角色之外，聆听其艺术人生的独白、音乐理念的碰撞，以及不同文化背景下的舞台生命力。让我们共同期待，在文化广场的舞台上见证这些闪耀的名字，用最诚挚的歌声，连缀成一条横贯世界音乐剧的星河。

音乐剧明星洛朗·班音乐会

        洛朗·班（Laurent Ban），一个伴随中国法语音乐剧观众共同成长的名字。在《巴黎圣母院》《小王子》《摇滚莫扎特》《摇滚红与黑》《唐璜》……这些中国观众熟知的音乐剧世界巡演中，总能看到他多变而迷人的身影。他以“百变男主”的深厚功力，跨越风格各异的角色，皆在他富有感染力的演绎下焕发独特光彩。2025年，他的艺术旅程延伸至中文原创音乐剧舞台，与中国舞台结下了更为深厚的缘分。

        本次音乐会，洛朗·班将携多位挚友同台献艺：包括共同出演《大鼻子情圣》的琪娅拉·迪·巴莉（Chiara Di Bari）、在《摇滚红与黑》中默契搭档的斯特凡妮·施莱瑟（Stéphanie Schlesser），以及来自中文原创音乐剧《长安十二时辰》的著名演员冒海飞。演出还将特别融入中国民乐元素，并由SCS音乐剧合唱团倾情助阵，在东西方音乐语汇的创造性交织中，焕新经典旋律，共谱一段跨越文化的和鸣。

        从巴黎的钟声到长安城的回响，“老航班”已准备就绪，即将为所有等待已久的乘客，再次启航！

制作出品：上海文化广场剧院管理有限公司
总策划：费元洪
制作统筹：高悦
制作人：张良辰 马辰兮
主题策划：洛朗·班 Laurent Ban
技术统筹：关达豪
舞台监督：项天翔
舞美设计：李奥
灯光设计：何逸伦
多媒体设计：真舍文化
音响设计：厉紫薇 张谐阳
宣发统筹：刘欣圆 郑天然 李心怡 朱思儒
营销推广：顾莹 伏莹莹
合唱团统筹：吴杰琳

 

        In the Spring of 2026, a stellar feast that transcends languages and stages will soon shine brightly. From the legendary redemption of Les Misérables in London West End to the poignant echoes of an era in Broadway Miss Saigon; from the romantic poetry of French musicals to the classical gravitas of German Language musical stages—the souls that live within the songs will step out of their stories and meet on the same stage.

        As a highlight of the "Show Life—2026 Shanghai International Musical Festival," this concert series brings together leading voices from London West End, New York Broadway, and the German-Austrian and French musical scenes. Among them are cherished friends who have graced the stage of the Shanghai Culture Square Theater multiple times, as well as accomplished vocalists making their debut solo concert appearances in Shanghai.

        Spanning the entire spring season, over ten performances will unfold one after another. This is not merely a curated retrospective of productions but a profound dialogue on stage—beyond their iconic roles, audiences will witness introspective monologues on their artistic journeys, the dynamic collision of musical ideas, and the vibrant energy of the stage across diverse cultural contexts. Let us eagerly anticipate these shining names as they gather on the stage of the Shanghai Culture Square Theater, weaving their most heartfelt melodies into a galaxy of stars that bridges the world of musical theatre.

SYNOPSIS

        Accompanied with the growth of French musical fans in China, Laurent Ban has been seen in world tours of beloved productions including Notre-Dame de Paris, Le Petit Prince, Mozart L'opera rock, Le rouge et le noir, and Don Juan. Each role he has interpreted, glows the unique glamor with his performance. In 2025, his artistic journey extends to original Chinese musicals, deepening his connection with stages in China. 

        In this concert, Laurent Ban will share the stage with several close friends including Chiara Di Bari, (Cyrano de Bergerac), Stéphanie Schlesser(Le rouge et le noir), and Mao Haifei (The Longest Day in Chang'an). The concert will also include elements of Chinese folk music, with SCS Musical Choir joining in at the same time. Through the creative interweaving of Eastern and Western musical languages, classic melodies will be revitalized, composing a cultural harmony that transcends boundaries.

        From the bells of Paris to the echoes of Chang'an, the “Old Flight” is ready to take off once more, taking off for all passengers who have waited so long!

音乐剧明星德鲁·萨里奇音乐会

        在2019年与2025年两度随《西尔维斯特·里维和他的朋友们：德语音乐剧明星音乐会》亮相上海文化广场后，德鲁·萨里奇（Drew Sarich）凭借极具辨识度的嗓音与充满戏剧张力的舞台表现，在中国观众的心中留下了深刻印记。从柏林到百老汇，再到上海，他以一贯的真诚、炽烈与全情投入征服着每一个舞台。他既是迪士尼音乐剧《钟楼怪人》中孤独而深情的卡西莫多，也是百老汇音乐剧《吸血鬼莱斯特》里优雅而危险的阿尔芒；他曾在伦敦西区与百老汇的《悲惨世界》中诠释过动人心魄的冉·阿让，也曾在《吸血鬼之舞》《万世巨星》《摇滚芭比》等作品中展现惊人的角色跨度与情感深度，是音乐剧舞台上的“全能叙事者”。

        此次音乐会，萨里奇将携手曾出演《贝隆夫人》《蜘蛛女之吻》的音乐剧明星安·曼德雷拉（Ann Mandrella），共同回望其舞台生涯的经典篇章。一个被中国观众期待已久的音乐之夜，即将由他亲自揭开序幕。

        As a highlight of the "Show Life—2026 Shanghai International Musical Festival," this concert series brings together leading voices from London West End, New York Broadway, and the German-Austrian and French musical scenes. Among them are cherished friends who have graced the stage of the Shanghai Culture Square Theater multiple times, as well as accomplished vocalists making their debut solo concert appearances in Shanghai.

        Spanning the entire spring season, over ten performances will unfold one after another. This is not merely a curated retrospective of productions but a profound dialogue on stage—beyond their iconic roles, audiences will witness introspective monologues on their artistic journeys, the dynamic collision of musical ideas, and the vibrant energy of the stage across diverse cultural contexts. Let us eagerly anticipate these shining names as they gather on the stage of the Shanghai Culture Square Theater, weaving their most heartfelt melodies into a galaxy of stars that bridges the world of musical theatre.

SYNOPSIS

        After appearing twice at Shanghai Culture Square in 2019 and 2025 with Sylvester Levay and His Friends: The Musicals of Kunze & Leavy in Concert, Drew Sarich has left a deep impression on Chinese audiences with his instantly recognizable voice and highly dramatic stage presence. From Berlin to Broadway, and now to Shanghai, he has captivated audiences with his trademark sincerity, intensity, and total commitment to every performance.

        Sarich has portrayed a remarkable range of iconic roles: he is the lonely yet tender Quasimodo in Disney’s The Hunchback of Notre Dame, and the elegant yet dangerous Armand in the Broadway musical Lestat. He has also delivered a deeply moving portrayal of Jean Valjean in Les Misérables in both the West End and on Broadway, while demonstrating extraordinary versatility and emotional depth in productions such as Tanz der Vampire, Jesus Christ Superstar, and Hedwig and the Angry Inch. Widely regarded as a ‘master storyteller’ on the musical theatre stage, Sarich brings powerful narrative force to every role he inhabits.

        For this concert, Sarich will be joined by musical star Ann Mandrella, known for her performances in Evita and Kiss of the Spider Woman, and look back together on the defining chapters of his stage career. A musical evening long awaited by Chinese audiences is about to unfold, with Sarich taking centre stage.

音乐剧明星阿尔菲·博伊音乐会

        阿尔菲·博伊（Alfie Boe）最深入人心的角色莫过于《悲惨世界》中的冉阿让——从伦敦女王剧院到百老汇复排版，从25周年纪念音乐会到世界巡演，他的演绎被誉为“最具代表性的冉阿让之一”。此外，他亦在百老汇音乐剧《寻找梦幻岛》中担任主演，并凭《波希米亚人》复排版与全体演员共同荣获托尼奖。其个人专辑在英销量突破百万，嗓音既能轻松驾驭歌剧的高亢辉煌，又能在音乐剧的独白中传递出直击人心的情感张力。

        此次音乐会，阿尔菲将携手伦敦西区“音乐剧天后”凯瑞·艾利斯（Kerry Ellis）同台献演。凯瑞塑造了多个令人难忘的大女主角色，其中在伦敦西区上演的《魔法坏女巫》（Wicked）中扮演的艾尔菲芭摘得了英国《节目导报网》“角色最佳演绎”奖。2025年年初，凯瑞在上海文化广场成功举办了个人音乐会，实力与气场俱获认可。

        两位西区Vocal担当首度在上海同台，相信将给观众们呈现一场纯粹而震撼的人声盛宴。

        Alfie Boe is most renowned for his deeply moving portrayal of Jean Valjean in Les Misérables — from London's Queen's Theatre to the Broadway revival, from the 25th-anniversary concert to the world tour. His performance is hailed as "one of the most definitive interpretations of Valjean." Additionally, he starred in the Broadway musical Finding Neverland and, along with the entire cast, won a Tony Award for the revival of La Bohème. His solo albums have sold over a million copies in the UK. His voice effortlessly navigates the soaring brilliance of opera while conveying emotionally resonant tension in musical solos.

        For this concert, Alfie will share the stage with Kerry Ellis, hailed as the "First Lady of West End Musicals." Kerry has brought to life numerous unforgettable leading roles, earning the UK's WhatsOnStage Award for "Best Takeover in a Role" for her performance as Elphaba in the West End production of Wicked. In early 2025, Kerry successfully held her solo concert at the Shanghai Culture Square Theater, where her exceptional talent and commanding stage presence were widely acclaimed.

        This marks the first time these two vocal powerhouses from the West End will perform together in Shanghai, promising audiences a pure and breathtaking feast of vocal artistry.

item.title: 《影·曜》德语音乐剧明星音乐会
item.description:
• 演出日期：2026.4.29-2026.5.1
  • 入场时间：约演出前30-60分钟
  • 演出类型：音乐会
  • 演出时长：100分钟
  • 演出语言：德语

演出介绍

       2026音乐剧明星音乐会系列

        2026年新春，一场跨越语言与舞台的星光盛宴即将璀璨启幕。从伦敦西区《悲惨世界》的传奇救赎，到百老汇《西贡小姐》的时代悲歌；从法语音乐剧的浪漫诗意，到德奥舞台上的古典厚重——那些活在歌声里的灵魂，即将走出剧情，在同一个舞台上相遇。

        作为“演艺大世界——2026上海国际音乐剧节”的重磅章节，本次音乐会系列汇聚伦敦西区、纽约百老汇、德奥与法语音乐剧领域的领军之声。他们中既有多次登台文化广场的挚友，也有首次以个人音乐会亮相上海舞台的实力唱将。

        跨越整个春天，十余场演出将陆续绽放。这不仅是一次剧目的浓缩回顾，更是一场舞台上的深度对话——在他们的经典角色之外，聆听其艺术人生的独白、音乐理念的碰撞，以及不同文化背景下的舞台生命力。让我们共同期待，在文化广场的舞台上见证这些闪耀的名字，用最诚挚的歌声，连缀成一条横贯世界音乐剧的星河。

《影·曜》德语音乐剧明星音乐会

        当「影」（Schatten）与「曜」（Glanz）在旋律中交织，德语音乐剧中永恒的戏剧张力于此绽放。《影·曜》不仅是一场视听盛宴，更是四位曾闪耀于上海文化广场的德语剧坛明星的荣耀重聚。

        颜·阿曼（Jan Ammann）曾凭借《路德维希二世：国王归来》中富有感染力的演绎，将这位传奇国王的浪漫与挣扎深深印在上海观众的脑海中；而马丁·马克特（Martin Markert）则在该剧中分饰影子人与奥托两个角色，以细腻演技展现出复杂人性的不同侧面；安妮米可·凡·丹（Annemieke van Dam）穿梭于《伊丽莎白》中追求自由的皇后与《蝴蝶梦》里充满秘密的管家之间，展现出令人惊叹的角色跨度；安东尼娅·卡林诺斯基（Antonia Kalinowski）在《蝴蝶梦》中以她极具表现力的嗓音，完成了令人难忘的国际舞台首秀。他们的演绎，早已与上海文化广场的舞台记忆紧紧相连。如今，他们再度聚首，以多部里程碑作品选段，串联起德奥音乐剧的艺术脉络。

        影曜之间，经典重生，星光再度为上海舞台点亮。

制作出品：上海文化广场剧院管理有限公司
总策划：费元洪
制作统筹：高悦
制作人：马辰兮
艺术总监、导演：马丁·马克特 Martin Markert
技术统筹：关达豪

宣发统筹：刘欣圆 郑天然 李心怡 朱思儒 顾莹


        In the Spring of 2026, a stellar feast that transcends languages and stages will soon shine brightly. From the legendary redemption of Les Misérables in London West End to the poignant echoes of an era in Broadway Miss Saigon; from the romantic poetry of French musicals to the classical gravitas of German-language musical stages—the souls that live within the songs will step out of their stories and meet on the same stage.

        As a highlight of the "Show Life—2026 Shanghai International Musical Festival," this concert series brings together leading voices from London West End, New York Broadway, and the German-language and French musical scenes. Among them are cherished friends who have graced the stage of the Shanghai Culture Square Theater multiple times, as well as accomplished vocalists making their debut solo concert appearances in Shanghai.

        Spanning the entire spring season, over ten performances will unfold one after another. This is not merely a curated retrospective of productions but a profound dialogue on stage—beyond their iconic roles, audiences will witness introspective monologues on their artistic journeys, the dynamic collision of musical ideas, and the vibrant energy of the stage across diverse cultural contexts. Let us eagerly anticipate these shining names as they gather on the stage of the Shanghai Culture Square Theater, weaving their most heartfelt melodies into a galaxy of stars that bridges the world of musical theatre.

SYNOPSIS

        When "shadow" (Schatten) and "radiance" (Glanz) intertwine through melody, the eternal dramatic tension of German musicals comes to life. "Schatten & Glanz" is not only an audiovisual feast but also a glorious reunion of four stars who once shone brightly on the stage of the Shanghai Culture Square.

        Jan Ammann, with his captivating performance in Ludwig2 : The King is Back, etched the romance and struggles of the legendary monarch into the memories of Shanghai audiences. Martin Markert, portraying both the shadow man and Otto in the same production, showcased the multifaceted complexities of human nature with nuanced artistry. Annemieke van Dam moved seamlessly between the freedom-seeking empress in ELISABETH and the secretive housekeeper in REBECCA, demonstrating breathtaking versatility. Antonia Kalinowski delivered an unforgettable international stage debut in REBECCA with her powerfully expressive vocals. Their performances have long been intertwined with the stage memories of the Shanghai Culture Square. Now, they reunite to weave together the artistic lineage of German-language musicals through selections from multiple landmark works.

        In the interplay of “Schatten” and “Glanz”, classics are reborn, and starlight once again illuminates the Shanghai stage.

演出介绍

舞剧《托马斯·谢尔比的救赎》改编自BBC现象级剧集《浴血黑帮》（Peaky Blinders），由剧集原创者史蒂文·奈特亲自编剧并改编为舞剧形式，围绕一战末期伯明翰剃刀党首领托纳斯·谢尔比构建商业帝国与卧底格蕾丝·伯吉斯的炽热恋情展开，融入未在荧幕呈现的独家剧情与角色设定，以肢体叙事剖开汤米的战争创伤与灵魂救赎之路；本剧由兰伯特舞蹈团艺术总监本诺伊特·斯旺·普弗执导编舞，完整兰伯特舞蹈团登台演出，现场乐队演奏Roman GianArthur定制音乐及Nick Cave等标志性曲目，极致工业暗黑美学的舞美设计、逼真枪声、频闪灯光等舞台特效营造沉浸式震撼；该剧于英国首演时引发观众10分钟抢空票的热潮，广受《星期日快报》《电讯报》等媒体五星赞誉，2026年3月将开启亚洲首巡并登陆中国上海，为观众带来原汁原味的暴力美学与摇滚融合的一战阴霾下的枭雄救赎史诗。

剧情梗概

一战后的伯明翰，家族灵魂人物托马斯·谢尔比在权力与罪恶中崛起。当卧底特工格蕾丝的爱火点燃他冰封的灵魂，商业帝国的扩张与爱情的背叛交织成血色挽歌。舞剧以肢体叙事剖开汤米的战争创伤与救赎之路——索姆河战壕的梦魇、伯明翰街头的暴力、情感与理智的角逐……每个动作都在嘶吼：救赎与毁灭，只在托马斯的一念之差！

item.description:

  • 演出类型：音乐剧

演出介绍

*2月14日为春节放假调休工作日，请合理安排观剧行程。

法国兰蔻 倾情呈现
法语原版音乐剧《巴黎圣母院》

        法语原版音乐剧《巴黎圣母院》取材于法国文豪维克多·雨果同名世界名著，由欧美乐界顶尖才子吕克·普拉蒙东（Luc Plamondon）谱词，理查德·科西昂特（Richard Cocciante）作曲，其强烈而具有震撼力的现代音乐，极具视觉效果的舞台布景，尽情投入的表演，生动表达出了原著的包罗万象、时间和命运的主题，对教会和封建制度的揭露和鞭挞、对教会人士邪恶行径和贵族卑劣的精神道德的抨击，以及对人道主义仁爱精神的颂扬。剧中角色与场面充满对立及冲突：倾慕与狂恋，誓言与背叛，权利与占有，宿命与抗争，原罪与救赎，沉沦与升华，跌宕起伏的戏剧张力，建构成一部波澜壮阔血泪交织的悲剧史诗，跨越时代潮流与文化藩篱，开创当代音乐剧的新纪元。


        本剧率先于1998年1月的法国嘎纳唱片大展中绽放异彩，同年9月16号正式在巴黎国会大厅推出首演，撼动人心佳评如潮。首演未及两年，其魅力风潮迅速袭卷欧陆，此剧在法语系国家连演130场，盛况空前，同时荣获加拿大FELIX艺术奖项“年度剧作”、“年度最佳歌曲”与“年度最畅销专辑”多项殊荣。《巴黎圣母院》的足迹遍布全球，感动了超过1200万观众，被欧洲媒体誉为“21 世纪最伟大的流行音乐剧”。


        2011年，音乐剧《巴黎圣母院》英文版首次来到上海文化广场，开启“年末大戏”这一每年冬天最令上海戏剧观众期待的文艺盛事。14年来，《巴黎圣母院》在这里已上演逾百场，一次次的全场大合唱，成为最激动人心的上海舞台盛景。2026年1月，在小说出版195周年之际，这部法语音乐剧经典之作即将第六次登上文化广场的舞台，由全球高档化妆品领军品牌兰蔻倾情呈现，再次敲响岁末的钟声，在中国和全世界的旅程也将继续……


剧情梗概

        法语原版音乐剧《巴黎圣母院》改编自法国文豪维克多·雨果同名巨著，故事的场景设定在1482年的巴黎圣母院，讲述由副主教克洛德·弗洛罗养大的圣母院驼背敲钟人卡西莫多与一名美丽的吉卜赛少女爱丝梅拉达的悲惨爱情故事。
